faqs.question: Do you take a percentage of what I charge?
faqs.answer: No. You pay a flat monthly subscription and keep 100% of every project fee you invoice. We never touch the money.

faqs.question: What if I get no matches one month?
faqs.answer: The tools are the point — your profile, jurisdiction lookup and pipeline keep working whether or not a match lands. That’s the retention floor.

faqs.question: Do I need a license?
faqs.answer: Architects do, and we verify it before you go live. Most other disciplines — drafting, 3D, scanning, rendering — need no license at all.

faqs.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monthly plans cancel at the end of the cycle; annual plans run to term. Applying is always free — you only subscribe once you’re approved.

faqs.question: What does "rolling out" mean?
faqs.answer: Proposal generation and client updates are being released market by market as density justifies them. We won’t pretend a tool exists before it does.

faqs.question: What’s the difference between Studio and Practice?
faqs.answer: Studio covers matches and the day-one tools. Practice adds the full jurisdiction database, AI intake, scope templates and proposals — the toolkit for running real project work.
